free_tier.stated: 30 GB uncompressed per build ('the itch.io backend will reject builds with a total uncompressed size that exceeds 30GB'). No documented total-account storage cap; project pages have a soft limit of 20, raisable on request. Free to host, unlimited downloads.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 30 GB uncompressed per build/channel; per-object-cap on HTML5 embeds: 500 MB total extracted and 200 MB per single extracted file; web uploader caps at 2 GB (500 MB default) but butler has no such limit; request-rate not a practical constraint. Retention: builds persist until deleted; no TTL.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered — 'There is no limit to downloads' (itch.io support reply). Files served from itch.zone CDN.

tooling: `butler` CLI (butler push / butler download / butler status) plus the Wharf HTTP API — GET https://api.itch.io/wharf/latest?target=user/game&channel_name=X returns the build manifest. butler does rsync-style block diffing so re-pushes are cheap.
chaining: 30 GB per build x unlimited channels per project (channel name is arbitrary: windows, osx, bonus, dlc-1, shard-01...) x up to 20+ projects per free account. 1 project x 20 channels = 600 GB on one free account. Each build is independently addressable and downloadable.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 30 GB uncompressed per build/channel; per-object-cap on HTML5 embeds: 500 MB total extracted and 200 MB per single extracted file; web uploader caps at 2 GB (500 MB default) but butler has no such limit; request-rate not a practical constraint. Retention: builds persist until deleted; no TTL.
reliability_note: Pushing the same directory twice is a no-op, so versions accumulate as distinct builds rather than overwriting; butler auth uses an API key, and a project can be taken down by moderation (technical effect: URL 404s, data gone).

evidence.proved: 'Limits: currently, the itch.io backend will reject builds with a total uncompressed size that exceeds 30GB.'
'butler is a more advanced uploader and has no such technical limits'; web uploader 2 GB ceiling
'There is no limit to downloads'; butler raises per-project limit to 2 GB instantly, further on request
probe: GET -> 200 {"errors":["invalid game"]} — endpoint is live and validating, i.e. the manifest read path is public
probe: GET -> 200, 39871 bytes, image/png — itch.zone CDN serves originals anonymously, no referer chain

notes: 30 GB uncompressed per build ('the itch.io backend will reject builds with a total uncompressed size that exceeds 30GB'). No documented total-account storage cap; project pages have a soft limit of 20, raisable on request. Free to host, unlimited downloads.
binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
